name: Knowledge Triple Model
description: Define the knowledge triple model: subject-predicate-object with provenance and confidence. Triples form the atomic unit of the memory knowledge graph.
purpose: Establish a structured knowledge representation where all memories can be expressed as subject-predicate-object triples with verifiable provenance, enabling graph traversal and reasoning.
acceptanceCriteria: Knowledge triple schema: subject, predicate, object, confidence, provenance, timestamp
Subject and object are entity references (canonical or literal)
Predicate is a defined relation from a controlled vocabulary
Provenance includes source agent, source action, and source timestamp
Triples support namespacing for extension-specific predicates
Triple create, read, delete operations are supported
rollback_strategy: Restore previous triple schema; migrate triples to previous format
recovery_strategy: Rebuild triple index from canonical memory store
